mapper.select: select * from product where status = 1 order by create_time desc
select * from product where category_id = #{categoryId} and status = 1 order by create_time desc
select * from product where status = 1 and (name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by create_time desc
select * from product where status = 1 and is_hot = 1 order by sales desc limit #{limit}
select * from product where status = 1 and is_new = 1 order by create_time desc limit #{limit}
select * from product where status = 1 and is_recommend = 1 order by sales desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into product(category_id, name, description, price, original_price, stock, sales, images, thumbnail, specifications, status, is_hot, is_new, is_recommend) values(#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{originalPrice}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{images}, #{thumbnail}, #{specifications}, #{status}, #{isHot}, #{isNew}, #{isRecommend})
mapper.update: update product set stock = stock - #{quantity} where id = #{id} and stock >= #{quantity}
update product set sales = sales + #{sales} where id = #{id}
